evidence.reviewer_disagreement_reviewed: The skeptic argued for shipping more than one quote, since seven ratings exist and one testimonial reads thin. Rejected on evidence rather than taste: of the seven, two are the operator's family, two have no published project on this site, and one - Palm Breeze - reads as a genuine business client but its work is not published here. Publishing an unverifiable client quote on a client's own site is the failure AGENTS.md names explicitly. The resolution is a mechanical gate rather than a one-off decision: a quote may run only if its portfolioId already exists in lib/portfolio.ts, so the set grows the moment the underlying work is published. The taste reviewer accepted one card looking sparse in a two-column grid, on the grounds that a thin honest section beats a full invented one.
evidence.winner_rationale: Encoding the admission rule as a test beats curating a list by hand. The alternative - reviewing each new five-star as it arrives - is exactly the judgement call that lets a friend's review slip onto a client page months later when nobody remembers the rule. Tying admission to published portfolio work also creates the right incentive: to publish more testimonials, publish more of the work.

booking_or_authority_thesis: A service business with zero visible social proof converts nothing even when it ranks. The profile now holds real review equity and the site showed none of it.
